description: We are conducting a confidential search for a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact on resident care and operational excellence within a supportive environment.The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and fostering a positive, resident-centered culture. This role demands a leader who can inspire staff, optimize operations, and maintain high standards of quality care.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Proven experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage facility operations, financial performance, and regulatory compliance.
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and team-building skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
